description: Set up Material 3 theme (green #10B981 as primary, white and neutral colors), app-wide state management with provider, and main navigation structure with bottom nav bar (Dashboard, Appliances, Analytics, Settings). Depends on FEAT-002 services and FEAT-003 storage.
steps: Add provider dependency to pubspec.yaml (^6.0.0 or latest)

Create lib/theme/app_theme.dart - define Material 3 theme with ColorScheme.fromSeed(seedColor: Color(0xFF10B981)) for green, white background, neutral gray for accents, configure TextTheme with Material 3 defaults
Create lib/providers/app_state.dart - ChangeNotifier that holds electricity rate, appliances list, current selected tab, notifies listeners on changes
Create lib/screens/dashboard_screen.dart - placeholder StatelessWidget (to be implemented in FEAT-005)

Rewrite lib/main.dart: use MaterialApp with theme from app_theme.dart, MultiProvider wrapper with AppState provider, home widget with bottom nav bar (BottomNavigationBar with 4 items: Dashboard, Appliances, Analytics, Settings icons)
Implement bottom nav tab switching logic that displays corresponding screen
Add Material Icons dependency (already in cupertino_icons, use Icons class)
acceptance_criteria: Theme uses green #10B981 as primary color
Bottom nav bar displays 4 tabs with correct icons and labels
Tapping tabs switches between screen placeholders
AppState provider initialized with sample appliances from ApplianceService
All screen files created and imported
verification: Run: flutter pub get — provider added
Run: flutter analyze lib/theme/ lib/providers/ lib/screens/ lib/main.dart — no errors
Run: flutter run (or build) and manually verify: app launches, bottom nav bar visible with 4 tabs, tapping each tab switches screens
